title: The King Who Looked Up
old_p1: King Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great, tall tree full of fruit. Daniel gently told him what it meant, and asked him to be kind to poor people.
But the king walked in his palace, a king’s grand house, and said, “Look at great Babylon, which I built by my own power!” He forgot that everything came from Heavenly Father.
old_p2: For a long time the king lived outside with the animals. He ate grass like oxen, big farm animals, and his hair grew long like feathers.
Then the king looked up to heaven, and his good mind came back. He praised Heavenly Father, whose kingdom lasts forever, and he was a king again.
Heavenly Father welcomes us back when we look up to Him. Tonight, look up at your ceiling and feel thankful for all He gives you.
p1: King Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a tall tree full of fruit. Daniel told him what it meant. He asked the king to be kind to the poor.
But the king forgot. He said, “I built this great city by my own power!” He thought only of himself.
A voice from heaven said he must learn that Heavenly Father rules. For a long time, his mind was not well. He lived outside with the animals and ate grass.
p2: At last the king looked up to heaven, and his good mind came back. He praised Heavenly Father. Now he was humble, remembering every good thing comes from Heavenly Father.
You can remember that too. Tonight, look up and thank Heavenly Father for three good things.
